decisive_items: 'Description': 'Mild cerebral atrophy/aging more pronounced in the curvatures of the cerebral hemispheres. Few, micro-ischemic focal lesions in the periventricular and deep white matter of the cerebral hemispheres'
response.rationale: R2 is directly supported by MRI showing micro-ischemic lesions in periventricular/deep white matter, characteristic of small vessel disease. R1 relies only on partially empty sella, which is nonspecific and not diagnostic of NPH without other features like ventriculomegaly or gait/cognitive triad.

rejected.why: Partially empty sella is not sufficient for NPH; no ventriculomegaly or classic triad mentioned.
